matrix.fixtureCalibration: Inventory buffer is 11300 basis points, restoring the existing 31.5 kg -> 36.5 kg suggested-order story. Earlier 8 development checks used 11000; these are not formal pilot trials.
matrix.baselines: All four modes enforce the same protected evidence contract. Row mode includes table fences, key absence epochs and row generations. No weak baseline is exposed as a commit mode.

timingPlan.scope: Local direct service validation; cold capture and real commit costs reported separately, no user-time or deployment-cost claims

matrix.interpretation: Functional repetitions are deterministic replay checks, not independent field cases. Injected SQLite exceptions are not process crashes or power loss. Child-process reopen/retry is normal process recovery. All SQLite runs use one database authority boundary; no distributed, multi-writer throughput or production rate is claimed.
